body:
This error is also typically shown when there is a trailing comma in a function call.

I’ll have a chat with @devversion tomorrow.

@alan-agius4 I confirmed locally that switching to `terser` worked. It initially didn't work in https://github.com/IgorMinar/angular/commit/3f8cf1232650be5c3eecb20ec012814986413e16 because the rollup config change has not been applied to the AIO boilerplate, but rather to the concrete rollup config primarily used for doc regions.

So this change was actually a noop and on CI uglify was still used. I'll double-check tomorrow again.

The context for the failure is that now uglify runs on ES2015 output, as there is no downleveling step that converts the Angular framework es2015 output to ES5. Previously, rollup would have just included the ES5 output from the Angular framework packages. Now it fails because uglify does not support es2015 syntax.
@devversion glad to hear it’s fixed.  Feel free to add me as a reviewer.

issue.body:
We recently disabled the e2e tests for `upgrade-phonecat-2-hybdrid`
because the switch to APF 10 caused it to fail with an uglify
error. More details in an dedicated issue here: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/36957.

We can re-enable the test by switching to Terser that properly
handles ES2015 syntax. Previously the rollup bundle consisted
only of ES5 output as the Angular framework packages provided
ES5 output. With APF 10, there is no ES5 output except for the
non-optimizable UMD format.

Hence we either need to downlevel code to ES5, or use Terser
that supports ES2015 syntax.

Closes #36957.
